subject.title: [Feature]: Expose an inbound non-message event hook to external channel plugins (e.g. reactions)

question: Should external channel plugins surface non-message activity through the existing system-event/inbound-runner APIs, or should OpenClaw add a new public channel event hook, adapter, or runEvent contract?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap, but the answer sets public Plugin SDK compatibility, channel authorization, routing, dedupe, and cross-channel semantics that automation should not choose.

options.title: Document the system-event recipe first
options.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events using current runtime helpers, document the external-channel recipe, and only add code if a plugin sketch proves structured semantics are missing.

options.title: Sponsor a generic event contract
options.body: Define a typed channel event hook or runEvent API that covers reactions, edits, deletes, typing, presence, and read receipts, then align the related Discord and WhatsApp hook work to it.

options.title: Defer pending concrete plugin proof
options.body: Ask for a minimal Zoho Cliq plugin sketch showing why system events plus runChannelInboundEvent cannot solve the use case before expanding the SDK.

recommendation.title: Document the system-event recipe first
recommendation.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events using current runtime helpers, document the external-channel recipe, and only add code if a plugin sketch proves structured semantics are missing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin SDK, channel inbound, and runtime-helper history makes this the strongest available routing owner for the API direction choice.
